gen.title: Recall of key facts about ocean acidification

cards.stem: Which structure is described as built from carbonate ions?
cards.quote: Carbonate ions are an important building block of structures such as sea shells and coral skeletons.

cards.stem: What gas uptake is named as the primary cause of long term pH decline?
cards.quote: a reduction in the pH of the ocean over an extended period of time, caused primarily by uptake of carbon dioxide

cards.stem: About how much of the released gas does the ocean absorb?
cards.quote: The ocean absorbs about 30 percent of the CO2 that is released in the atmosphere

cards.stem: Which animal is listed among those that struggle to build shells when carbonate ions fall?
cards.quote: difficult for calcifying organisms such as oysters, clams, sea urchins
